summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose the termination of a prior private placement and the closing of a new private placement of 100,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.20 per share for gross proceeds of US$20,000,000. The company executed the subscription agreements with investors on April 16, 2026, the same day as closing. The shares are subject to a six-month lock-up. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms are derived from this filing beyond standard issuance and lock-up. There is no strategic transaction, activist event, or termination of a material definitive agreement triggering special-situation classification.
